content: Hey love, I found something incredible today, remember that place we talked about? It's even better in person. I honestly started imagining our mornings there together.
Really? You actually went to see it? That's amazing! Tell me more, I want all the details.
Absolutely! It's bright, spacious, with a little balcony perfect for sipping coffee. The landlord said a lot of people are interested, but I told him you and I were really serious.
It sounds perfect for us. I wish I could have been there with you. How much is the deposit? Do you think we can get it?
He's asking for $2,500 as a non-refundable deposit to hold the apartment. He won't wait long, but I told him we're committed. I know it's a lot, but this is our chance, honey.
That's a big sum, but I trust your judgment. Are you sure we won't lose it?
I promise, love. I even checked the contract, everything looks legitimate. The landlord just wants to be sure we're serious. All we have to do is send the deposit today, and the place is ours.
Okay. How do I send the money? Should I use my bank or is there another way?
He prefers Zelle, since it's quick and secure. Can you send it from your Chase app? His Zelle handle is j.smith.rentals@gmail.com. Let me know when you're ready, and I'll walk you through it.
Alright, I can try. Just to be sure, is there any paperwork I'll get after sending?
Of course, sweetheart. As soon as he receives the transfer, he'll email the official confirmation and lease draft. I can send you a copy as soon as I get it. I want you to feel safe about this.
Thank you, that helps. What if Zelle asks for his full name or phone number?
No problem, his full name is Jonathan Smith, and his number is 347-555-1923. Just enter those if prompted. And don't worry, I'll be right here if you need help.
Okay, I'm logging into my app. Should I put anything specific in the memo?
Just write 'apartment deposit.' That way it's clear and professional. If you have any questions, message me immediately, alright?
This is all happening so fast. Are we really doing this?
I know it's sudden, but opportunities like this don't come twice. I wouldn't ask if I wasn't sure it was right for us. We deserve this new start together.
You're right. I trust you. Sending now. Should I send you a screenshot after?
That would be perfect, love. It helps me confirm he received everything. After this, we can celebrate, our future is finally coming together.
Alright, it's processing. It says it may take a few minutes.
No worries, darling. Just let me know when it's complete, and I'll handle the rest. I really can't wait to start this new chapter with you.
